text:
nina: Quick question  leaving next month as a contractordo I get paid out for my banked PTO or does it auto-expire? Im in EMEA so curious about local rules.

josh: Hey @nina  usually contractors' banked time handling depends on contract terms + local law. We typically pay out accrued but unused PTO for terminated contractors in most jurisdictions, but need the termination checklist and manager confirmation.

hr-bot: Policy excerpt: Contractors vs employees differ by jurisdiction. Payouts for accrued time are governed by local employment law and contract. People Ops will initiate payout requests where legally required. Full policy: https://intra.redwood.com/hr/pto-termination-policy

payroll-liz: @nina pls note: payroll needs the last working day, termination reason, and manager approval in Workday (or contractor portal) before cutoff to run in the same cycle. If after cutoff, payout runs next cycle. Also need currency/banking details for cross-border payments.

mari: for EMEA contractors: check if local law mandates carryover vs payout. e.g., in some countries accrued paid leave cannot be paid out if contract explicitly disallows it  we had one case in DE where payout required extra signoff.

nina: ok will send manager signoff today. last day is 1981240000 (tentative). if it slips past payroll cutoff what's realistic delay?

payroll-liz: if you miss cutoff, expect one payroll cycle delay (~2 weeks). if urgent, people-ops can request an exception but must route to finance for early off-cycle payment; that can take 3-5 business days.

josh: checklist for you @nina:
- confirm last working day with manager (pm @mari)
- manager adds termination note + approves payout in contractor portal
- file termination + payout request: https://intra.redwood.com/hr/forms/termination-payout
- cc payroll-liz and people-ops@redwood.com if you need same-cycle processing

nina: thanks all  sending manager note now and attaching bank details.

hr-bot: Reminder: international payouts may incur taxes/withholding. People Ops will advise on local requirements once contract details are provided.

josh: we'll follow up once manager signoff is in. closing thread when payroll confirms processing.
